main_decision: Topology-stratified, branch-contrast recurrent conditional generation; MDN before flow; GRU before history attention.
global_rules: Do not modify or reset B1/A17/upstream ledgers or locked datasets.
All new material-frequency, RHS, adjoint, JVP, setup and rejected evaluations are charged.
Separate finite-state target correctness from continuous posterior and general-geometry claims.
Split by material parent before noise replication when claiming geometry generalization.
Use three training seeds for decisive small-model comparisons; no test-set hyperparameter tuning.
Report parameter/data matched and total-cost matched comparisons separately.
No OPM/current selection; no large diffusion/Transformer training; no global certificate sweep.
Never invent missing modes or a probability for an unmodeled other class.
Only a held-out reproducible gate result can authorize promotion to a later stage.

preferred_architecture.normalized_generator: MDN first; conditional affine/spline coupling flow if needed
preferred_architecture.production_context: freeze independent pilot states before generating fresh production samples
preferred_architecture.fast_mode: calibrated event head plus conditional samples
preferred_architecture.corrected_mode: full likelihood and density-corrected stratified integration; finite-N error reported

experiments.model: H in {-1,+1}, P(H=+1)=0.7; a~Uniform(0.5,1.5); x=H*a; y1=a^2+N(0,sigma1^2); optional y2=kappa*H*a+N(0,sigma2^2)
experiments.reference: Independent scipy.quad and refined Gauss-Legendre quadrature; sign prior exactly unchanged at kappa=0
experiments.stop: If reference or probability semantics fail, debug here; do not move to EM.

experiments.purpose: B1 finite material hypothesis benchmark; implementation/calibration not algorithm superiority
experiments.model: The exact 18 B1 analytic scalar TM states: solid/fixed cavity x 9 real permittivities, common declared loss and geometry
experiments.reference: Exact logsumexp finite prior with stored full-wave responses; replicate B1 conventions before changing them
experiments.required_hard_cases: Predefined high-noise/single-frequency ambiguous subset with non-extreme reference probabilities; label any post-hoc difficulty adjustment exploratory
experiments.stop: No claim of continuous posterior, geometry generalization, vector Maxwell or learned speedup over enumeration.

reference_gate.meaning: empirical integration agreement, not a rigorous certificate

promotion_alternatives: At least 10 percent reduction of mean reference excess log score with paired-parent confidence interval excluding zero and no worse calibration/support, at matched total cost.
At least 25 percent reduction in total charged solver/wall cost at mode mass MAE <=0.02, with no material-coverage degradation.
experiments.stop: If only raw neural FLOPs improve, if oracle fields are required, or if state features never beat the simple conditional generator, reject the physics-state architecture claim.

experiments.purpose: Sequential architecture elimination, not a large model zoo
experiments.data_policy: Reuse identical approved training/reference data and already charged physics-state traces where mathematically valid.
experiments.gate: Promote a more complex model only on held-out proper-score/mode-coverage versus total-cost Pareto improvement, never best-of-K alone.
experiments.stop: At most two architectures survive to E4; GRU winning means drop the Transformer; MDN/flow winning means drop diffusion.

experiments.purpose: Difficult material ambiguity and prior/solver/nuisance shift
experiments.gate: Report mode precision/recall, event probability error, calibrated rejection and missing-mode risk by stratum. Do not average away the hard cases.
experiments.budget: Separate approval required; no implied authorization from E0-E3.

experiments.first_physics: 3-D concentric layered dielectric sphere with full vector Mie electric/magnetic multipoles and declared polarizations; solid versus finite-size cavity
experiments.first_continuous_parameters: Two material variables per branch, with proper priors; widen only after reference convergence

reference_gate.meaning: research tolerance, not certified mathematical error

experiments.next_physics_if_approved: A small independently checked vector VIE/DDA family with nonspherical shape and physical polarizability derivatives
experiments.stop: REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED at cap; spherical vector validation is not evidence for arbitrary complex 3-D topology.
